description: Check whether a German company has insolvency proceedings. Search by name, register number (e.g. "HRB 12345") and/or town. Each result has the proceeding stage with date, case number (Aktenzeichen) and court, a match quality (exact / register / similar), and the list is flagged `ambiguous` when several companies fit. `proceeding.stage`: vorlaeufiges_verfahren (petition filed, preliminary measures), eroeffnet (proceedings opened), abgewiesen_mangels_masse (petition dismissed for lack of assets — usually the end of the company), schlussverteilung (final distribution), insolvenzplan (plan confirmed, under supervision), aufgehoben (proceedings closed), unklar (only follow-up notices in the database).

name.description: Company name or part of it, e.g. "Müller Bau GmbH"

town.description: Seat / town, e.g. "Köln" — narrows ambiguous names
